abstention.form: constant logit offset on a single token, applied inside the model's forward pass by modeling_abstain.Qwen3AbstainForCausalLM (requires trust_remote_code)
abstention.equivalence: signal = logP(UNKNOWN) - logP(top1) = z_UNK - z_top1, so 'signal >= threshold' is exactly 'argmax(z + b*e_UNKNOWN) == UNKNOWN' with b = -threshold
abstention.known_deviation: sequence_bias applies at every decode step; the gate is defined on the first generated token only
abstention.generation_config_route_rejected: transformers 5.14 serialises GenerationConfig.sequence_bias with string keys and then refuses to load them ('sequence_bias has to be a dict with tuples as keys'), so the offset cannot ride in generation_config.json
